items.period: Shang oracle-script style attribution on Commons; the cited Sinica source is image 41.EEDF, but this redraw page does not provide an artifact date.
items.tradition: Oracle-bone script style, modern vector redraw
items.caption: Modern redraw of 父 in an oracle-script form, based on Sinica Database image 41.EEDF. 父 is the semantic component listed in analyses of 爸.
items.alt: A black line drawing of the character 父 in a form labeled Shang oracle script style.
items.selection_reason: Offers a documented oracle-script-style comparison for the semantic component 父. The Commons page links it to an identified Sinica source image and supplies CC0 terms. It is component evidence only, not an attested early 爸 form.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 / public domain, as stated on Commons; attribution appreciated.

items.period: Labeled Shang oracle-script style by Commons; not independently dated as an artifact.
items.tradition: Oracle-bone script style, modern vector redraw
items.caption: Modern redraw of 巴 in an oracle-script style, based on Richard Sears Chinese Etymology image J30397. The comparison illustrates the phonetic component cited for 爸; it does not show the snake/object's recoverable ancient name.
items.alt: A black line drawing of the character 巴 in a form labeled Shang oracle script style.
items.selection_reason: A documented early-script-style comparison for the phonetic component 巴. The Commons page identifies its source image and reuse statements. Its proposed phonetic role does not imply a semantic link between the depicted form and father.
items.rights: Commons labels the representation public domain and also records Sears-site courtesy, permission and copyright terms under its agreement; check the linked agreement/source terms.

items.period: Shuowen seal-script style; modern vector drawing, not a dated seal artifact.
items.caption: Modern redraw of 父 in Shuowen seal-script style, based on Sears image s02164. It can be compared with the oracle-style 父 drawing to show contrasting script presentations of the semantic component.
items.alt: A black line drawing of 父 in a form labeled Shuowen seal script style.
items.selection_reason: Provides a later script-style comparison for 父 alongside the oracle-style component image, making clear this is a modern reconstruction and not evidence for 爸's own graphic chronology.
items.rights: Commons labels the vector representation public domain and also records Sears-site courtesy, permission and copyright terms under its agreement; check the linked agreement/source terms.

limitations.text: The three proposed image URLs are direct original-file links copied from inspected Commons pages, but direct retrieval through the web tool failed (cache miss or unsupported SVG content type). Images were not visually inspected.
These are component comparisons only. No candidate depicts an independently attested historical form of 爸 itself.
The 巴 seal file was omitted because its page could not be inspected to confirm image identity or reuse provenance.
